title: Twitch says it intends to use videos streamed on its platform to help train Amazon's generative AI models and tells creators how to opt out (Amanda Silberling/TechCrunch)
summary: Amanda Silberling / TechCrunch: Twitch says it intends to use videos streamed on its platform to help train Amazon's generative AI models and tells creators how to opt out — The streaming platform Twitch will now use creators' content to help train generative AI models for its parent company, Amazon.
